description: This file defines an enum for representing the status of standing instructions in the account domain of the Fineract system, including status codes and utility methods.

classes.name: StandingInstructionStatus
classes.description: An enum representing the various statuses of standing instructions, such as INVALID, ACTIVE, DISABLED, and DELETED, including utility methods for status evaluation.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an integer status value to its corresponding StandingInstructionStatus enum value.

methods.name: hasStateOf
methods.description: Checks if this status has the same state as the provided status.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the standing instruction status.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code associated with the standing instruction status.

methods.name: isDisabled
methods.description: Checks if the standing instruction status is DISABLED.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Checks if the standing instruction status is DELETED.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if the standing instruction status is ACTIVE.
